Name: Sir Robert's Kaleidoscope of Flowers
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]This mod features pretty flowers in colorful vases and pots for you to decorate your farmhouse in Stardew Valley. Mix and match them with plants and flowers from my other mods. Go wild and crazy with decorating! It's flower time!!![/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Basically, I created this mod because I wanted to have the ability to mix & match flowers with my own colorful pots, vases or clear glass vases. I decided to start with tulips (the shape of the flower is from the actual game), poppies and pansies. I also "recycled" flowers from my previous mods. There aren't any sunflowers this time around though! [/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods. The main folder will contain images for the Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. Once downloaded, the images will appear in the Decor/Houseplant section of the furniture catalog or Happy Home Designer.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Main features[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Images #1 through #10 consists of flowers that can be placed upon [u]end tables[/u].[/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Image #11 consists of flowers that I moved up a few pixels and will fit best upon [u]countertops[/u].[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Requirements[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Requires Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. I also recommend using Happy Home Designer. [/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]The end tables shown in the pictures are from mods created by Platinum Cats, Orangeblossom7, stardust, and Riruru. I also used end tables from the actual game. [/size][/color]
